data: Which of the following LM types are included in the figure?

The figure includes three types of Linear Mixed Effects (LM) models: GRU, Transformer, and 2L Transformer. These are represented by different symbols and colors in the scatter plots and smooth lines in the GAMs. Therefore, the answer is:

GRU, Transformer, and 2L Transformer.
